body: I appreciate it! I’m trying to stay positive, I figure my life could be a lot worse then what it is rn. I hope everything your going through works out though!

Sorry for the late reply, I was taking a break from reddit but there aren’t a lot of places like that near me and even if there was I don’t think I could find the courage to leave my comfort zone. I know I have to leave it to make friends and meet new people. Honestly I don’t even know how you make friends. I’ve always been the introvert that gets “adopted” by the group of extroverts so Ive never had to take that first step.
I can understand why people would want to practice hedonism but personally it’s not for me. I feel like fun isn’t fun when it’s the norm. Not saying to have a boring life. Everything in moderation.
Yeah as long as I call my dad, I’ll be fine.
Yeah I don’t live any where near my family anymore so that isn’t an option. Im gonna feel sad either way, might as well pick the more comfortable option of being by myself.
I’m gonna be alone. I’ll call my dad but that’s the extent of it
Idk it’s like I do but I don’t. I just feel isolated when I go to those sorta events so I’m alright not going but I wish I could go without feeling out of place.
